result.title: Fine-Tuning Diffusion Language Models with Context Selection and Target Weighting
result.comment: 30 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. Main text 10 pages, references and appendix follow. Project page with interactive visualizations: https://loaym.github.io/GoldiMask/
result.summary: Supervised fine-tuning of discrete diffusion language models masks some response tokens and trains the model to recover their original values from the visible context. The masking pattern therefore determines both the context available to the model and the tokens it learns to predict. Uniform random masking does not explicitly account for the interaction between these choices. We introduce GoldiMask, which selects tokens to reveal as context by approximately maximizing a submodular objective. This objective uses model signals to balance the benefit of revealing tokens against their value as prediction targets. GoldiMask then weights the remaining targets according to how they benefit from the selected context and their remaining learning potential. Across three backbones and three training datasets, GoldiMask achieves the highest average accuracy in most evaluated settings, demonstrating gains on both reasoning and code generation. Component ablations show that both context selection and target weighting contribute to the gains. GoldiMask also reduces decoding iterations on GSM8K and MATH-500 under confidence-threshold parallel decoding, while maintaining comparable accuracy at higher confidence thresholds.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 GoldiMask，用于离散扩散语言模型的监督微调：以子模目标近似最大化来挑选揭示为上下文的 token，并按受益程度与剩余学习潜力对预测目标加权，在多个骨干与数据集上提升了推理与代码生成准确率，并在 GSM8K/MATH-500 上减少并行解码迭代数。
AI.relevance_reason: 训练期上下文选择与目标加权属于对「哪些信息进入状态、哪些位置承担监督」的显式分配，其子模选择与收益-潜力加权思路可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、latent 位置监督与贡献分配问题；但论文限于纯文本离散扩散，未涉及视觉或多模态状态，迁移需自行验证。
